entities.summary: Old Republic, a political institution in Brazil during The Old Republic and the Vargas Era (1889–1930). Led to the emergence of War of Canudos — millenarian community destroyed by army, 1897 and Semana de Arte Moderna (Modern Art Week) in São Paulo.
